usefulFacts.furniture: Fixed tables; movable chairs; seat numbers and counts require on-site arrangement.

publicViewerReview.finding: The only polygon is corridor (C)3W010, 372 sq ft. It does not identify any target classroom wall or place the auditorium.

runtimeDecision.reason: The seating diagrams confirm room identities but provide neither a reliable complete wall outline nor scale. Neither a rectangle fitted to listed area nor a guessed campus position is warranted.

additionalSourcesChecked.finding: Official venue page corroborates the 300-seat J.R. Beyster Auditorium in Wells Fargo Hall. Its visible linked content is venue photography and rental information; no dimensioned floor drawing was obtained.

limitations: Seating capacity and seat-number layout do not establish an architectural wall footprint.
The not-to-scale warnings apply even when a rectangular black frame appears around a diagram.
The FIS inventory area 3570 sq ft for 1W102 and 5478 sq ft for 1N108 is preserved as listing evidence; it is not used to turn schematic rectangles into floor plans.
All five original floor levels and six unplaced classroom records remain intact; no shared manifest, coverage, docs or tests are changed.
